name: Cherepanovo-Suzun Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline
researcher_notes: No match in GGIT roster (Novosibirsk/Suzun/Cherepanovo search; nearest rows are Novosibirsk-Barnaul and Omsk-Novosibirsk trunks, not this). Sponsor: Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Tomsk (company press service per Kontinent Sibir 2024-10-23); 112 km inter-settlement line Cherepanovo GDS -> Suzun serving 9 settlements under the Novosibirsk Oblast 2021-2025 gasification program; construction began Oct 2024; regional ministry (4s-info 2025-03-25) says 40 km built, completion 2026. Independent: company press release vs regional-ministry statement (related but separately published). Suzungazeta (2024-12-19) reports 53+ km laid and March 2026 completion but the verifier did not find '53' in fetched text, so not cited. Caveat: this is a regional gas-distribution trunk (Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie operates distribution, not transmission); diameter, pressure, capacity not found; Parent=Gazprom is inferred from the Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie name, verify Parent/Owner wording with researcher. Owner entity not in tracker (entity_lookup no match). Status 'construction' as of 2025-03; may be operating by 2026-09 (completion planned 2026) - not verified. Route: none found, no official GIS.
